title: GridWorld Committed Benchmark: Baseline Blackout vs Simulation-Guided Relief
scientific_finding: On authentic Grid2Op chronic 0003, Line 17 initializes in severe thermal overload (rho=1.028). Under Do-Nothing, thermal protection trips after 2 steps and triggers complete network collapse at Step 3. The simulation-guided controllers simulate candidate actions around the overloaded corridor, discover that switching Line 7 relieves Line 17 below emergency thermal rating (rho=0.991), and survive all 10 steps.
